UFC 319 Du Plessis vs. Chimaev Betting Odds & Fight Preview


UFC 319 delivers a thrilling Middleweight Championship matchup as reigning champion Dricus du Plessis defends his title against undefeated sensation Khamzat Chimaev. Du Plessis, known for his relentless pace and unpredictable striking, looks to continue his dominance after impressive victories over top fighters such as Sean Strickland, Robert Whittaker, and former champion Israel Adesanya.


Challenger Chimaev enters this bout as the betting favorite, with odds around -205, showcasing strong market confidence in his aggressive wrestling and powerful finishes. However, the champion Du Plessis is a compelling underdog at +170, drawing interest due to his ability to weather early storms and overwhelm opponents as fights progress.


The card also features intriguing matchups including Michael “Venom” Page (-180) taking on veteran Jared Cannonier (+150) and Kai Asakura (-345) heavily favored against Tim Elliott (+275).


Prelim fights to watch include Loopy Godinez (-250) against Jessica Andrade (+210) and Chase Hooper (-275) facing Alexander Hernandez (+235).


With multiple competitive lines throughout the card, UFC 319 presents ample betting opportunities. Fans and bettors alike should anticipate an electrifying evening capped by a dramatic clash of styles in the main event.


Date: Saturday, August 16, 2025

Location: United Center in Chicago
